checkpoint.purpose: SKU condition alignment v2 (four table steps: identical first, mutual best match, contained strings marked extra, axes paired one to one): similarity matrices from japanese-reranker-small-v2 for the 29 confirmed pairs and the family set, value pairs, axis split, decisions, diff against rule gate v10, the Codex handoff, the score for the 29 pairs and the manual axis reference.
checkpoint.extract_at: repository root; preserve .lab-output relative paths; use unzip -n
checkpoint.label_derived_content: legacy/align/score.json holds aggregate counts against the Luna v3 machine labels of the 29 confirmed pairs and Claude's manual axis reference (not blind). No raw labels; family has no labels. The method was designed after reading v1 scores.
